title: Past meetings
text:
The first meeting of the Cologne Skill Space was a full success. More than three people showed up and that didn’t include the organizers.
Following a general discussion about what the CSS could be, Dr. Albert Deuker held a presentation about Newell’s famous constraints paper (Newell 1986). Afterwards a dicussion developed about to what extent this framework is actually usefull as a scientific theory.
